HOW IT WORKS

A clear workflow from start to finish

Batch reminders are a planned Invonxt workflow. The current application can identify overdue balances, prepare customer statements, and email supported documents with attachments, but a dedicated multi-customer reminder action was not verified in the application repository.

01

Find overdue accounts

Use invoice status, due dates, and outstanding balances to identify customers requiring follow-up.

02

Review the selection

Confirm each customer, invoice, amount, due date, and email address before preparing messages.

03

Tailor the reminder

Use respectful wording and include the exact invoices, balances, payment instructions, and requested response date.

04

Send and document follow-up

The planned workflow groups delivery; today, use customer statements and supported email attachments individually.

KEY CAPABILITIES

Everything you need for this workflow

Overdue visibility

Identify invoices whose due dates have passed and balances remain outstanding.

Customer selection

The planned workflow groups relevant customers before any reminder is prepared.

Message review

Tailor reminder wording before sending rather than relying on an unchecked generic message.

Statement context

Use account statements to summarize invoices, recorded payments, and remaining balances.

Email attachments

The verified email service supports sending statements and supported attachments.

Payment history

Check partial and complete payment records before contacting a customer.

WHY IT MATTERS

Turn the feature into a better business process

A structured reminder process saves preparation time while keeping customer communication accurate, respectful, and connected to the correct billing records.

01

Prioritize overdue balances

Due dates and outstanding amounts help focus follow-up on accounts that genuinely need attention.

02

Keep messages consistent

A reviewed message structure reduces omissions without removing customer-specific context.

03

Avoid incorrect reminders

Checking payments, credits, disputes, and contact details before sending prevents avoidable customer friction.

PRACTICAL CHECKLIST

Use batch payment reminders well

  • Verify the current balance immediately before follow-up.
  • State invoice numbers, due dates, and requested next steps clearly.
  • Pause follow-up when an invoice is disputed or a payment is being reconciled.
Always confirm the legal, tax, and record-keeping requirements that apply to your business.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about batch payment reminders

Can I send reminders to several customers today?

A dedicated batch-send reminder action was not found in the audited application repository, so it is presented as planned.

What can I use now?

Invonxt currently supports overdue-balance visibility, customer statements, email delivery, and supported attachments.

Should every customer receive the same message?

No. Review the customer, invoice, disputed items, partial payments, and relationship before sending.

Will a reminder collect payment automatically?

No. A reminder communicates an outstanding balance; it does not itself charge the customer.
